posts.t: Washe hit Zegras as he was leaping in the air to bat down a puck. Acciari didn't like that very much, and went after Washe. I get the sentiment on Acciari's part (kinda scummy to lay a hit in that situation), but it results in a Ducks power play.
Third penalty of the game drawn by Noel Acciari, this time in the offensive zone. Flyers back to the PP.
Acciari draws another penalty and sends the Flyers back to the PP. On LaCombe, too. That's LaCombe's third penalty of the night, and 2nd drawn by Acciari.

Acciari gets a SH breakaway -- doesn't finish, but draws a penalty and ends that Anaheim PP.

Acciari shouldn't stay on Line 1 once everyone is healthy. But over the past few games, he's basically been the guy the Flyers thought they were signing. Useful, likeable bottom-sixer.
Noel Acciari hurting after blocking a Samuelsson shot, hobbled off the ice and went down the tunnel.
